headword: コミュニケーション{能力|のうりょく}
reading: こみゅにけーしょんのうりょく

definitions.explanation: The ability to communicate effectively with others, including speaking, listening, reading social cues, and building relationships. Highly valued in Japanese society and frequently cited as a key trait in job recruitment.

examples.japanese: コミュニケーション{能力|のうりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{職場|しょくば}→職場：04164_shokuba⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{重宝|ちょうほう}→重宝：14415_chouhou⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: People with strong communication skills are valued in the workplace.

examples.japanese: ⟦{就活|しゅうかつ}→就活：05832_shuukatsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧コミュニケーション{能力|のうりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{最|もっと}も→最も：01736_mottomo⟧⟦{重視|じゅうし}される→重視する：26832_juushisuru⟧。
examples.english: In job hunting, communication skills are considered the most important quality.

examples.japanese: コミュニケーション{能力|のうりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{高|たか}める→高める：02065_takameru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{日頃|ひごろ}→日頃：07284_higoro⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{積極的|せっきょくてき}→積極的：01585_sekkyokuteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{関|かか}わる→関わる：03020_kakawaru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: To improve your communication skills, it's important to actively interact with people on a daily basis.

notes:
A compound of the loanword ⟦コミュニケーション→コミュニケーション：08425_komyunikeeshon⟧ (communication) and ⟦{能力|のうりょく}→能力：03541_nouryoku⟧ (ability). Extremely frequently abbreviated to ⟦コミュ{力|りょく}→コミュ力：08820_komyuryoku⟧ (komyuryoku) or simply ⟦コミュ{力|りょく}→コミュ力：08820_komyuryoku⟧ in casual speech and writing.

COMMON ABBREVIATION:
⟦コミュ{力|りょく}→コミュ力：08820_komyuryoku⟧ (komyuryoku) — the standard informal abbreviation, widely used in everyday conversation, social media, and business contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- コミュニケーション{能力|のうりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧/⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧ — to have high/low communication skills
- コミュニケーション{能力|のうりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{磨|みが}く→磨く：02427_migaku⟧ — to polish one's communication skills
- コミュニケーション{能力|のうりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{高|たか}める→高める：02065_takameru⟧ — to improve communication skills
- コミュニケーション{能力|のうりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{問|と}う→問う：02299_tou⟧ — to assess communication ability

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦コミュ{障|しょう}→コミュ障：06461_komyushou⟧ — communication difficulties (slang, short for ⟦コミュニケーション→コミュニケーション：08425_komyunikeeshon⟧⟦{障害|しょうがい}→障害：03228_shougai⟧; used self-deprecatingly for social awkwardness)
- ⟦{対人|たいじん}→対人：28357_taijin⟧⟦{能力|のうりょく}→能力：03541_nouryoku⟧ — interpersonal ability
- ⟦{社交性|しゃこうせい}→社交性：23779_shakousei⟧ — sociability
- ⟦{話術|わじゅつ}→話術：21732_wajutsu⟧ — art of conversation; speaking skills

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japanese employers consistently rank コミュニケーション{能力|のうりょく} as the most desired quality in new graduates. In the Japanese context, this encompasses not just speaking ability but also the capacity to read the atmosphere (⟦{空気|くうき}を{読|よ}む→空気を読む：06306_kuukiwoyomu⟧), collaborate harmoniously, and express oneself with appropriate sensitivity to social context.
